requirement: The book preprocessor MUST escape requirement names and link targets when inserting badge HTML. It MUST encode badge label and message text in Shields.io URL path components so punctuation cannot change the badge URL structure.
rationale:
The code meets `requirements.references.safe_badges`, but one escaping path has no test, so the requirement is not fully satisfied.

**Code (all reachable from the `{impl}` items `src/lib.rs#fn[reference_badge]` and `src/lib.rs#fn[replace_definitions]`)**
- Shields.io URL path encoding: `src/lib.rs#fn[shield_badge]` calls `shield_path_component` on the label and message. That function keeps `[A-Za-z0-9.]`, turns space into `_`, doubles `_` and `-`, and percent-encodes every other byte. The whole URL is then passed through `escape_html`.
- Escaping names: `shield_badge` escapes the label and message in the `alt` text. `replace_definitions` uses `escaped_name`, built with `escape_html`, in the anchor, the permalink and the `aria-label`.
- Escaping link targets: `reference_badge` escapes the chapter href with `escape_html`. `replace_definitions` escapes the detail-page href with `escape_html(&chapter_href(...))`.

**Tests**
- URL encoding and `alt` escaping: `badge_urls_percent_encode_punctuation_and_html_is_escaped` and `shields_badge_urls_escape_requirement_names`.
- Reference-badge link target escaping: `reference_link_targets_are_escaped` runs `preprocess_book` with a target path containing `& " < >` and asserts the escaped href.

**Gap**
The escaping of the detail-icon href and of the name in `replace_definitions` is never tested with special characters.
- The detail path comes from `src/index.rs#fn[detail_path]`, which is `chapter.with_extension("").join("{name}.md")`. A chapter path can therefore put HTML-special characters into the link target.
- The existing tests that touch the detail icon (`index_owns_details_in_book_order_with_badge_icons` and `definitions_without_a_marker_get_a_default_index_and_detail_pages`) only assert that the icon and the `aria-label` prefix exist.
- The escaping is a transformation the code performs. It needs no network, elapsed time or process-wide state, so no testing exemption applies.
- No `{fixme}` acknowledges this gap.
